auditPolicy.inventory: Every exact source ID, official label and IRIS type is copied from the wave-8 IGN/INSEE inventory and checked for exhaustive coverage.
auditPolicy.numberedFamilies: A numbered or lettered family is dissolved only when its semantic base is identical and the union of exact official geometries is one connected Polygon.
auditPolicy.exactLabels: Context-rich directional, generic, operational, transport and genuinely numbered human labels require documented exact-ID acceptance; standalone direction-only labels are prohibited.
auditPolicy.opaqueInventories: Opaque technical and standalone direction-only labels require unique human renames backed by official IGN BD TOPO coordinates strictly inside each exact source polygon.
auditPolicy.prohibitedInference: No nearest-point, centroid-nearest, invented neighborhood, wildcard source selector, dropped cell or cross-parent merge is permitted.
